phase_boundary: Changes reset distribution only; ongoing episodes continue with original source level. No artificial terminal/truncation.
stop_rule: After both reach 50000: stop if neither has any completed training success or any validation success through step 50000 (including all four validation sets).
epsilon: Unchanged: 1 through step 1000; linear to 0.1 at step 81000, then 0.1; never reset.
validation: Every 10000 plus initial: 32 new fixed cases per level and original 32, greedy, no updates. These cases never enter replay.
best_checkpoint: Original32: max success rate, then min mean |x| among successful landings, then earliest; initial excluded. Separate per-level best policies.
diagnostics: Old fixed replay probe at every checkpoint; final new replay uniform minibatches with signed terminal/nonterminal TD and weighted shared gradients. No optimizer steps.
comparison: Previous beta10 differs in initial distribution and total budget; single seed, no causal attribution to curriculum alone.
